test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

My mother lovingly asked me if I was going to the party that night.

options.text: My mother asked me, "Are you going to the party tonight?"
My mother said to me, "Were you going to the party that night?"
My mother said to me, Were you going to the party that night?
My mother asked, " you going to the party that night?"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** My mother lovingly asked me if I was going to the party that night.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if I was going" becomes "Are you going"**
 
 
• Indirect question "if I was going" is converted to direct question "Are you going."
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "was going" is changed to "are going" to match the present tense in direct questions.
 
 
 
• **"that night" becomes "tonight"**
 
 
• Time expression "that night" is converted to "tonight" to reflect the perspective of the speaker.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "lovingly asked"
 
• Converted to: "asked" while maintaining the context.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Are" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause precedes the quoted speech, ending with a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My mother asked me, ‘Are you going to the party tonight?’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "My mother said to me, ‘Were you going to the party that night?’" 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "were you" changes the context to past instead of present.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "My mother said to me, Were you going to the party that night?" 
 
 
• Does not include proper punctuation for direct speech (missing quotation marks).
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "My mother asked, ‘you going to the party that night?’" 
 
 
• Lacks the auxiliary verb "Are" to form a correct question.
 
 
</ul
